value.rationale: The original modular Barth–Nieto threefold has a distinguished bad-reduction triple point with a crepant exceptional del Pezzo cubic surface, versus ten coalescing characteristic-zero node coordinates, while twenty singular lines survive. The canonical geometric bridge to the Segre cone persists even though its actual characteristic-two Hessian vanishes. This local birational behavior is geometrically motivated, and is independent of the already known arithmetic of the cubic.
